posts.text:
Two hundred and fifty years ago, America declared to the world that our rights come from God, not government, and that the people are sovereign.

That revolutionary event changed the course of history. 

Freedom has endured because generations of Americans have defended it with courage, sacrifice, and faith in God.

May we continue to have the wisdom to preserve liberty, uphold the Constitution, defend our sovereignty, and leave a stronger Republic to the next generation.

God bless the United S
